budget_unit: optimizer steps of 524288 tokens each, one forward and one backward per step
vocabulary_ceiling_announcement: The vocabulary ceiling is now the frozen embedding width, 50304, read from environment/nanogpt_substrate.json. It supersedes the 8192 ceiling the stand-in carried; the earlier ceiling described a table the stand-in allocated, and this one describes a frozen architecture dimension that cannot move without moving the model.
_budget_note: 3250 is the substrate's baseline_steps_to_target, record 36, read from the record set README and not chosen here. Fixed compute is that fixed step count. Because compute is fixed in STEPS and each step consumes 524288 tokens, a coarser vocabulary covers more BYTES of FineWeb inside the same budget while the per-token cost rises only slowly. That trade is the whole of the free axis, and it is why the metric is bits per byte rather than bits per token.
_evaluation_note: The three evaluation points are contiguous segments of the verifier's held-out FineWeb slice. That slice is absent from this directory and from every agent-visible container. See data_config.json.
